verdicts.reason: A leaves '20% off' alone in the middle and crams the subcopy, the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow and the legal line into one tiny strip at the bottom. The eyebrow ends up after the body copy, and the legal text is microscopic and wraps onto two lines, so the reading order is broken and there is dead space above the headline. B keeps a sensible left-aligned stack of headline, subcopy and eyebrow next to the can, but it moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the subcopy. Its legal line is too small to read, there is an empty gap between the text block and the circle, and the Shop Sale button sits almost against the right edge.
